mapper.select: SELECT s.ID, s.SOURCE_ID, s.COLLECTION_NAME, s.DIMENSION, s.DISTANCE_METRIC, s.METADATA_SCHEMA, s.INSTANCE_KEY, s.CREATE_TIME, s.UPDATE_TIME, s.CREATE_USER, s.UPDATE_USER, s.ENV_CODE, src.NAME AS SOURCE_NAME, src.PROVIDER AS SOURCE_PROVIDER, inst.INSTANCE_NAME FROM AI_VEC_STORE s LEFT JOIN AI_VEC_SOURCE src ON s.SOURCE_ID = src.ID AND src.DELETED = 0 LEFT JOIN AI_INSTANCE inst ON s.INSTANCE_KEY = inst.INSTANCE_KEY AND inst.DELETED = 0 WHERE s.ID = #{id} AND s.deleted = 0
